items.name: metro-theme
items.title: Metro theme
items.description: The metro fleet theme: the dark palette plus tokyonight, catppuccin, kanagawa, nord, dracula and gruvbox, the shadcn token mapping, the base layer and the shared component classes.

items.name: theme-store
items.title: Theme store
items.description: The fleet theme store: one preference under one key, applied as data-theme on <html>, dark by default. Framework-agnostic, no dependencies.

items.name: theme-switcher
items.title: Theme switcher
items.description: The fleet theme picker (a small menu, not a shadcn dropdown), identical in every service.

items.name: version-badge
items.title: Version badge
items.description: The application version and release channel, set next to the wordmark.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The fleet application shell: collapsible sidebar, mobile drawer, top bar with the brand, the version badge, the status slot and the actions slot. Everything service-specific is a slot.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status badge
items.description: Tone-based status badge built on semantic theme tokens.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: Page title, description and action slot.
